requirement: A changed record is named by its kind in words and its title, never by its record id, on the chat card, the undo dialog and the Site changes line; the Apply door keeps the dsh host's title only from its signed actor

oracle.ref: PR #1512 (fix); fix evidence: Local stand 20/10/2026 (#1480 voice run): the card under a reply said 'Nội dung · article 4'; in the local DB 370 of 13,129 site_write rows carried a title, because the Apply door kept {kind, id, fields} only (council D1, ~/tracy-bench-work/voice-mode/council/a6-codex.md).
oracle.invariant: Exit 0, 0 failures. targetText({kind:'article', id:'4', title:null}, say) is 'an article' and with title 'Yêu chính mình' is 'article “Yêu chính mình”'; WordPress 'post' reads 'a page or post' or the title alone; an unknown kind reads 'an item'; no output for article, post, services or menu_item contains a digit. whatOf counts records that read the same ('Content · an article, +1 more'); putsBackOf gives ['article “Yêu chính mình”', 'an article', '+1 more']. resourceText of a titled article reads 'Updated article “Yêu chính mình”'; untitled WordPress post 42 still reads 'Updated post 42' (E3.2); a titled WordPress post reads 'Updated “Home”'. writeTitleOf decodes, trims and puts on one line; '%', '%E0%A4%A', blank and absent give null; 300 characters cap at 200 without splitting an emoji.
